FAQ.title: Everything you want to know.
FAQ.subtitle: Clear answers to the questions we hear most often — from pricing to security, and everything in between.

q1.question: How much does Tamara cost?
q1.answer: Tamara starts at €49 (ex. VAT) / month on the Answering Service plan, with 500 minutes included. The Receptionist and Call Center plans unlock booking, multi-location and advanced routing. All plans have no commitment and can be cancelled anytime from the dashboard. See the full pricing grid above.

q2.question: How does the AI talk to my clients?
q2.answer: Tamara uses OpenAI Realtime voices — the same technology powering top-tier voice assistants. Latency stays under 300ms, the voice is natural, calm, with no choppiness or robotic feel. Clients feel like they're talking to a real receptionist.

q3.question: Does it understand Hebrew?
q3.answer: Yes. Tamara is natively trilingual: French, Hebrew and English. It auto-detects the language from the first words and switches mid-call if the client changes language. No setup needed — it just works.

q4.question: What happens for complex appointments?
q4.answer: If the situation goes beyond the configured workflows (medical emergency, unusual request, difficult caller), the agent can transfer the call to you or your team, or collect all the useful info and send you an instant WhatsApp recap. You stay in control.

q5.question: How do I install Tamara on my line?
q5.answer: Two options. Either we provision a dedicated Twilio number for you (included in every plan), or you set up a forward from your existing line — keeping your usual number. Setup takes five minutes from the dashboard, no technician needed.

q6.question: Is my data secure?
q6.answer: Yes. Tamara is GDPR compliant, hosts all data in Europe (Paris and Frankfurt), encrypts communications with TLS 1.3, and never stores raw voice recordings. Transcripts are kept for audit but accessible only to you.

q7.question: Can I cancel?
q7.answer: Anytime, from the dashboard, in one click. No penalties, no term commitment. You leave with your exportable data (contacts, call history, transcripts) if you wish.

q8.question: What if the AI makes a mistake?
q8.answer: Every call generates a complete timestamped transcript, accessible from the dashboard. You see exactly what the agent said and did — appointment created, contact added, call transferred. If there's an error, fix it in one click and the behaviour adjusts for the next calls.

welcome.introTextBody: Your Tamara voice assistant is now live on:
welcome.footerHtml:
Need help? Just reply to this email, we read everything.

welcome.footerText: Need help? Reply to this email.
welcome.reco1Body: Call {phone} from your phone and chat with her like a customer would. It's the best way to discover what she can do.
welcome.recoCalendarBody: Without a connected calendar, the agent can't book in YOUR calendar. Open your dashboard and click "Connect Google" — 30 seconds.
welcome.recoCrmBody: Every contact created by the agent is added automatically to your Google Sheet. Share it with your team if multiple people consult it.
welcome.recoWhatsappBody: Set your owner WhatsApp number in the Settings tab to receive an instant recap after every call.
welcome.recoPersonaBody: Go to Settings to tune the tone, hours, branches, and business rules. Default persona is "Tamara" — rename it and adapt it to your activity.
